dishes.name: Çökertme kebabı
dishes.desc: Thin strips of veal on a bed of fried potato matchsticks and yogurt, finished with butter. A signature of the Bodrum area.

dishes.name: Bodrum mantısı
dishes.desc: Tiny dumplings steamed or baked, served with garlic yogurt and tomato butter. The best-known home dish of Bodrum.

dishes.name: Sündürme
dishes.desc: Stretched, thin dough cooked on a griddle and filled with meat or cheese, then rolled. A traditional Muğla village dish.

dishes.name: Muğla köftesi
dishes.desc: Grilled meatballs with a geographical indication, seasoned simply and served with bread and salad. Milas and Muğla town are the home of this style.

dishes.name: Çiriş otu yemeği
dishes.desc: A wild herb of the Fethiye hills cooked with olive oil and onion, or in an egg dish. Typical of the Aegean herb tradition of the Muğla coast.
